description: This file implements a logging sink for writing logs to files, including functions to create log sinks from file paths and manage their lifecycle, utilizing the Abseil logging library.

classes.name: FileLogSink
classes.description: A custom log sink class that writes log entries to a specified file descriptor, supporting creation from a file path and managing its own lifecycle.

methods.name: FileLogSink::FromPath
methods.description: Creates a FileLogSink instance by opening a file at the given path and registers it as a log sink.

methods.name: FileLogSink::~FileLogSink
methods.description: Destructor that removes the sink from the logging system and closes the file descriptor.

methods.name: FileLogSink::Send
methods.description: Overrides the Send method to write a log entry to the file descriptor.

methods.name: LogToFiles
methods.description: Function to initialize log sinks for a list of file paths.
